articles.title: A 20-Year-Old Star Shines Bright in Scotland's First World Cup Win in 36 Years!
articles.summary: Imagine waiting 36 years for a World Cup win! Scotland finally did it, beating Haiti 1-0. The biggest surprise? A 20-year-old named Ben Gannon-Doak stole the show with his energy and passion.

articles.title: US Tells AI Company Anthropic: No Foreigners Can Use Your Smartest Models!
articles.summary: The US government just blocked people from other countries from using two super-smart AI models made by Anthropic. The company says the order is unfair, but the government says it's for safety.
